title: The evolution of egg shape in birds

about.name: Data from: The evolution of egg shape in birds: Evolutionary constraints and adaptations
about.quote: Using accurate measures of size and shape, we studied the eggs of 955 extant species across the avian phylogeny, including 39 of the 40 orders, and 78% of the 249 families.
about.label: Dryad

about.name: AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds
about.quote: The AVONET database contains comprehensive functional trait data for all birds, including six ecological variables, eleven continuous morphological traits, and information on range size and location.
about.label: figshare

here: Here: 420 of the 949 species that also appear in AVONET (sampled evenly across orders), as egg elongation, polar asymmetry and pointedness (A) and as hand-wing index, wing length, mass, tarsus and primary lifestyle (B).
